english.title: Operator of a private hire vehicle impose additional charge for carrying assistance dog accompanying a disabled person
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of a private hire vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX MARK..), made an additional charge for carrying an assistance dog which was accompanying **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a disabled person
english.legislation: Contrary to section 170(2) and (4) of the Equality Act 2010.

english.notes:
(i) In this section 'operator' means a person who holds a licence under-
(a) section 3 of the Private Hire Vehicles (London) Act 1998,
(b) section 55 of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976, or
(c) an equivalent provision of a local enactment;(ii) 'private hire vehicle' means a vehicle licensed under -
(a) section 6 of the Private Hire Vehicles (London) Act 1998,
(b) section 48 of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976, or
(c) an equivalent provision of a local enactment.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being the operator of a private hire vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX MARK..), made an additional charge for carrying an assistance dog which was accompanying **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a disabled person.
